selectionBasis: One visually inspected, structurally faithful revision-048 result per distinct successful surface mechanism. Explicit-cat and open-creature restatements are retained in Flux evidence but not reconstructed because they add no new elaboration mechanism.

launchCorrection.observed: The initial submitter repeated the Greenroom -p option. The CLI retained only texture_size; the route supplied seed, steps, and target_faces from its declared defaults.
launchCorrection.effectiveComparison: Every selected cast therefore uses the same Trellis seed 42, steps 6, target_faces 200000, and texture_size 1024. This fixed reconstruction seed is the authenticated comparison contract.
launchCorrection.futureSubmitter: submit_trellis.py now passes every parameter through one -p group. Existing jobs and their original requestedCommand records are not rewritten.
